Recipe Name French Onion Meatloaf with Melted Mozzarella Ingredients 1. 2 lbs (900 g) ground beef 2. 1 cup breadcrumbs 3. 2 large eggs 4. 1 small onion, finely diced 5. 2 large onions, thinly sliced 6. 3 garlic cloves, minced 7. 1/3 cup milk 8. 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 9. 2 tbsp ketchup 10. 1 tsp Dijon mustard 11. 1 tsp salt 12. 1 tsp black pepper 13. 1 tsp garlic powder 14. 1 tsp dried thyme 15. 2 tbsp butter 16. 1 tbsp olive oil 17. 1 cup beef broth 18. 1 tbsp all-purpose flour 19. 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese 20. 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Recipe 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Lightly grease a loaf pan or baking dish. 2. Heat the butter and olive oil in a skillet. Add the sliced onions and cook over medium-low heat for 20–25 minutes until deeply caramelized. 3. Stir in the garlic and cook for 1 minute. Sprinkle in the flour, then add the beef broth and simmer until slightly thickened. Remove from the heat. 4. In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, breadcrumbs, eggs, diced onion, milk, Worcestershire sauce, ketchup, Dijon mustard, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and thyme. 5. Mix gently until just combined, then shape into a loaf and place in the prepared pan. 6. Bake for 40 minutes. 7. Remove the meatloaf from the oven and spoon the caramelized onion mixture evenly over the top. 8. Sprinkle the mozzarella cheese generously over the onions. 9. Return the meatloaf to the oven and bake for another 15–20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted, bubbly, and lightly golden. 10. Let the meatloaf rest for 10 minutes before slicing. 11. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley for extra flavor and color. 12. Serve hot with creamy mashed potatoes and your favorite vegetables. Follow for more delicious and easy recipes!

VIRAL CHUCK ROAST✨ my most popular recipe for good reason! I’ve received 100s of messages from you about how this recipe has become a staple in your family’s dinner routine 🥹 Some of you are making it WEEKLY and I’ve gotten so much feedback specifically that your kids are loving it - which makes me so happy! Let me know in the comments how YOU enjoy this easy recipe and share it with someone you think would love this crowd-pleasing chuck roast!  Ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast (about 4 pounds) 2 teaspoons kosher sea salt  1 teaspoon black pepper  Instructions: Preheat your oven to 325. Season the roast generously on both sides with salt and pepper. Add to a baking large casserole dish or Dutch oven, cover (with a lid or foil), and bake for 1 hr per pound of meat. Remove the roast from the oven and raise the oven temperate to 425.  Using two forks, shred the meat into large chunks. (If the roast is not pulling apart easily, put it back in the oven for 30 min). Toss the shredded pieces of roast around in the rendered fat and place it back in the oven, uncovered, for 20-25 minutes until you see some nice crispy ends.  Serve with mashed potatoes or roasted vegetables and enjoy! FAQs:  My roast is less than 4 lbs, how long should I cook it? Use the “hour per pound” method. How do I choose a good beef chuck roast? Look for nice fatty roast with lots of marbling. A roast that is too lean will not render enough juice. (Note: I have hit or miss luck with grass-fed roasts. Most are just too tough/lean and don't render enough fat for this preparation.)  How many people does this serve? A 4-pound roast serves 6-7 people. Do I need to sear it first?  Nope! The last part of the cook will give it some nice crispy bits without searing.  Did you add liquid? No, that is the juice rendered from the meat. Get the recipe below or tap the link in @allrecipes bio to try it for yourself! 🍽️ Ingredients:  4 ounces cream cheese, softened 1/2 cup sour cream 1 cup shredded Monterey Jack cheese, divided 1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted 1/4 cup brine from pepperoncini peppers 1 (1-ounce) package ranch dressing mix 1 (1-ounce) package au jus gravy mix 1 cup milk 3 cups wide egg noodles (6 ounces), cooked according to package directions 3 cups shredded cooked chicken 1 cup sliced pepperoncini peppers Directions:  Gather all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a 2-quart baking dish with cooking spray. Stir together cream cheese, sour cream, 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese, melted butter, pepperoncini brine, ranch dressing mix, and au jus gravy mix in a large bowl until well combined. Stir in milk. Fold in cooked noodles, chicken, and pepperoncini peppers until evenly coated. Spread mixture into the prepared baking dish; sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese. Add seasonings. Add onions, carrots, and celery and cook until onions are softened and then add garlic. Cook for 1 to 2 mins and then add in beefy onion soup mix. Add butter and allow to melt, then add flour and stir for 2 to 3 mins. Add beef broth, bring to a gentle boil and add potatoes. Cover and cook 15 to 20 mins (or until potatoes are fork tender). Turn heat to low and add heavy cream, cheese, and chives. Mix well and serve. ✨ Creamy Garlic Chicken & Mashed Potatoes 🤍🧄🥔 🕒 Total Time: ~35 minutes 🍽️ Serves: 4-6 📋 Ingredients: • 2 lbs chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp butter • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half • ½ cup grated parmesan cheese • Garlic salt • Onion powder • Paprika • Black pepper • Mashed potatoes, for serving 👩🏼‍🍳 Directions: 1. Season chicken generously with garlic salt, onion powder, paprika, and black pepper. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from skillet and set aside. 4. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter to the skillet and let melt. 5. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes to create a roux. 6. Slowly pour in chicken broth while whisking until smooth and thickened. 7. Stir in heavy cream (or half-and-half) and parmesan cheese. Simmer until the gravy is rich, creamy, and silky smooth. 8. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over top. Simmer for 3-5 minutes. 9. Serve over warm mashed potatoes and drizzle with plenty of that creamy garlic gravy. ✨ This is the kind of dinner that has everyone asking for seconds and a piece of bread to clean the plate. 🤍 #CreamyGarlicChicken #DinnerAtRileys #ComfortFood #EasyDinnerRecipe #FamilyDinner

videos.caption: High Protein Honey Garlic Butter Chicken Mac n Cheese! Only 597 Calories!🍯🧄🍗 Made By: @Jalalsamfit  For All The Best & Simple High Protein Recipes In One Place Follow: @legends_cooking Follow My Main Account: @Mykhaylo  Macros: 597 Calories 59g Protein 52g Carbs 16g Fat Ingredients & Cooking Directions: Make 4 Servings Honey Garlic Chicken: 800g Raw Chicken Breast cut into cubes 1.5 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (leave it out if you don’t want it spicy) 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder 1.5 Tsp Onion Powder 1.5 Tep Paprika or Smoked Paprika 2 Tsp Olive Oil 30g Light Butter, for cooking + extra once cooked 2 Tsp Minced Garlic 30g Honey (15g Honey per batch of chicken) Handful Fresh Chopped Parsley Get a pan on medium heat first then add butter. Let it melt then add your chicken (don’t overcrowd the pan). Cook for 4-5 mins on one side first till you get a nice golden brown crust. Then cook the other side for 3-4 mins more. Lower the heat completely when adding the extra butter, garlic and honey. Mix till well coated and sticky then set aside. Garlic Mac n Cheese: Big Tbsp Minced Garlic 300ml Skimmed Milk 160g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia) 1 Tsp Salt or to taste 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika 1/2 Tsp Nutmeg (adds a great deep flavour!) 100g Low Fat Cheddar Cheese (You can use any low fat cheese you have available) 220g (Uncooked weight) Macaroni Pasta or any pasta of your choice On medium low heat cook the minced garlic in the residue butter from the chicken for 2 mins till fragrant. Then add milk, cream cheese, spices. Mix this till completely smooth then lower the heat before adding the cheddar cheese. Stir till it melts then add your cooked macaroni and give it a good mix then. Enjoy! #legends_cooking #lowcalorie #highprotein #healthyeating #healthyfood

Puerto Rican pollo guisado 🇵🇷🥘🍗🌿 Dinner ready in 30 minutes ⏲️  Chicken marinade  Drums (3x) and thighs (4x) 1 tbsp complete seasoning with adobo  1 tbsp of garlic powder  1 tsp of oregano and cumin 1/2 tsp salt 2 tbsp of sofrito  1 sazon packet  Drizzle of olive oil  Marinate for 30 mins to an hour  Pollo guisado  Half an onion  Half a green and red bell pepper  3 garlic cloves  Half can of tomato sauce  2 bay leaves  1/2 tsp adobo  1 packet of sazon 1/2 tsp chicken bouillon  1 tbsp of sofrito  Olives  2 medium sized russet potatoes  Directions  Clean your chicken and add seasonings, sofrio and oil to chicken and let marinate for 30 mins to an hour. Before cooking chicken take out the fridge to allow it to get to room temperature. In a pan add oil and brown chicken on both sides then remove chicken.  Add your onion and bell peppers to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes before adding garlic.  Add your sofrito, tomatoes sauce, seasonings and olive mixtung together. Allow to simmer until fragrant.  Add your chicken back to the pot with water enough to cover the chicken. Add the potatoes and your bay leaves and let cook for 20 minutes until your potatoes are fork tender. Chicken Francese…tried it for the first time in NY last year and fell in LOVE. This is my take ok? Also, might have done some false advertising with under 20 min but def under 30. Ingredients: * 2 large chicken breasts. * 2 eggs. * 1.5 tbsp milk or cream. * 1/4 cup grated parmigiano reggiano. * 2.5 tsp aleppo pepper. * 2 (1 just for the zest, 1/2 kept whole, and half cut into wheels and then halved). * 1/2 cup white wine. * 16 oz chicken broth. * 1 shallot (brunoise). * 1 large garlic clove (minced). * 1/4 cup parsley. * 2 tbsp chives (more for topping). * 5 tbsp unsalted butter. * 1 tsp soy sauce. * 1/4 cup flour. * salt and pepper to taste. Directions: 1. Butterfly the chicken breasts, then pound until desired level of thickness. 2. Whisk the eggs, add in 1 tsp aleppo pepper, the parm, milk and some seasoned salt. 3. Season your flour as well with salt and pepper. 4. Preheat a pan on high for 2 min. Add plenty of olive oil and lower to medium high. 5. Pat dry the chicken breasts, pass them through the egg wash. 6. Fry the chicken breasts on medium high until golden on both sides, about 2-3 min per side. 7. In another pan, preheat for 2 min as well. Add a bit of olive oil and the halved lemon wheels. Let them caramelize for about 2-3 min per side and remove. 8. On medium heat, add in the shallot and garlic. Deglaze with the wine and let it reduce by half. Add in chicken broth, lemon zest and soy sauce. Let it simmer until reduced by half. Should be like 8-10 min.  9. Squeeze in juice of 1/2 lemon, add aleppo pepper and herbs. Cook together for 2 more min. Turn heat off, add the butter and emulsify. 10. Serve the chicken with the sauce, more chives, the charred lemons and black pepper. #chicken #chickencutlet #chickenrecipes #chickenfrancese #dinner

Every bite is loaded with flavour🤌🏽 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 650 Calories | 52g Protein | 59g Carbs | 22g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6) Middle Eastern Chicken - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Paprika - 3 Tsp Cumin - 30g Honey - 80-100g Tomato Paste  - 1 Lemon Juice  - 30g Olive Oil Golden Herb Rice - 300g Uncooked Basmati Rice (Cook this beforehand) - 20g Light Butter - 100g White Onion, finely chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1.5 Tsp Turmeric - 1 Tsp Paprika - 1 Tsp Cumin Tabouleh Salad - 3 Cups Parsley, chopped - 300g Tomato, chopped and de-seeded - 150g Green Onion/Scallion, chopped - 15g Olive Oil - Lemon Juice - 1/2 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Sumac - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes Spicy Garlic Sauce - 300g Low Fat Yogurt - 100g Light Mayo - 120g Chilli Garlic Sauce (Lee Kum Kee) - 1 Tsp Paprika  - 1 Tsp Onion Powder - 1/4 Cup Evaporated Milk 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add the Middle Eastern spice mix, honey, tomato paste, lemon juice and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a pan over low heat. Add light butter and chopped onion, cook for 5 mins until softened. Stir in the seasoning and toast for 3-4 mins . Add cooked basmati rice, turn off the heat and mix until fluffy and golden. 3. In a bowl, combine chopped tomato, green onion, parsley, olive oil, seasoning and lemon juice. Mix well and refrigerate until ready to serve. 4. Spread the chicken on a lined sheet pan and oven bake at 200C / 400F for 20-25 mins, then broil/grill for 5 mins until golden and juicy. 5. While the chicken rests, whisk together yogurt, light mayo, chilli garlic sauce, seasonings and evaporated milk until smooth. 6. Serve with the spiced rice, fresh salad and garlic sauce. Creamy Peri Peri Chicken Pasta🍗🧀🍝 Another game changing sheet pan meal prep. This pasta tastes unreal, low effort, easy to make for the week!🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 592 Calories | 55g Protein | 54g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Peri Peri Chicken - 1500g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 3 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 4 Tsp Oregano - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Parsley - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Coriander/Cilantro - 1 Lemon Juiced - 8 Tsp Olive Oil - 100g Nando’s Peri Peri Medium Sauce (used to brush over the chicken before cooking) - Avocado Cooking Spray (4 Tsp worth) Creamy Peri Peri Pasta - 200-250g White & Red Onion, chopped - 200-250g Red & Green Bell Pepper, chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Oregano - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 120-150g Tomato Paste - 180g Light Cream Cheese - 400ml Light Evaporated Milk - 150g Peri Peri Medium Sauce - 480g Uncooked Protein Rigatoni Pasta / ~800-900g Cooked Pasta - Fresh Chopped Parsley 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs. Add seasoning, fresh parsley and coriander, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated and let marinate if time allows. 2. Line a sheet pan and spread the marinated chicken in a single layer. Brush with peri peri sauce and lightly spray with avocado oil. Bake in a preheated oven at 200C / 400F for 22-25 minutes until golden and juicy. While it cooks, boil the pasta, drain, and set aside. 3. Remove the chicken and keep all the pan juices. Add chopped onion and bell pepper, toss in the juices, spread flat, and roast at 180C / 370F for 15 minutes until soft and lightly charred. 4. While pan is hot, add extra seasoning, tomato paste, cream cheese, milk, peri peri sauce. Mix gently until melted creamy - the residual heat will help emulsify sauce. If needed, return to oven for 5 minutes. 5. Stir in cooked pasta and parsley until coated. Slice peri peri chicken, serve over pasta, and ENJOY! . . . #periperichicken #healthyrecipes #pasta #mealprep #sheetpandinner

Nashville Hot Chicken x Garlic Bread🔥 Crispy double-dredged Nashville hot chicken, with melty mozzarella, pickles, and homemade ranch, all packed onto garlic bread 😮‍💨 this thing will disappear FAST Garlic butter: 4 tbsp butter, softened 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 tbsp chopped parsley Chicken: 3 chicken thighs 3/4 cup flour 1/4 cup cornstarch 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp cayenne 1/2 tsp salt 2 eggs, beaten 4 cups oil, for frying Nashville hot sauce: 1/2 cup hot oil, reserved from frying the chicken 2 tbsp cayenne pepper 1 tbsp brown sugar 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp chili powder 1/2 tsp salt Ranch: 1/2 cup mayo 1/2 cup sour cream 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice 1 tsp dried dill 1 tsp dried parsley 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp salt 1/4 tsp black pepper To build: 1/2 loaf French or Italian bread 1 cup shredded mozzarella Sliced sweet pickles Steps 1.  Whisk flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, cayenne, and salt in a bowl. Beat eggs separately. 2.  Whisk mayo, sour cream, lemon juice, dill, parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper for the ranch. 3.  Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot or skillet. Dredge chicken in the flour mix, then egg wash, then flour mix again for a double coating. 4.  Fry until golden and 165°F internal, about 4-5 min. Drain on a rack. Save 1/2 cup oil for the Hot Oil 5.  Whisk the reserved hot oil with cayenne, brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, chili powder, and salt. Toss the fried chicken in the sauce. 6.  Preheat oven to 400°F. Spread garlic butter evenly on the split loaf. 7.  Top with mozzarella. Bake 5-6 min until fully melted. 8.  Remove and layer the sauced chicken on top, then add more cheese. 9.  Broil 3-4 min until the second layer melts. Remove.  10.  Top with pickles, then drizzle ranch over the top. 11.  Slice and serve Enjoy! #easyrecipesathome #garlicbread #nashvillehotchicken #cooking #viralrecipes

MOLTEN BROWNIES. The rich indulgence of a texture that collapses into molten lava. If you’ve ever been searching for a chocolate dessert that achieves the perfect balance of a crackled crust + a gooey, molten centre, this is for you. During my years operating as a private chef to various Royal Families across the Gulf, I quickly learned that despite the opulence, what the Lady of the House truly craved at the end of the day was pure, basic comfort food. This particular recipe became her absolute favourite treat because it stripped away unnecessary pretence + focused entirely on flawless execution. It’s a simple sensation, born from technical precision + a refusal to compromise on the quality of the ingredients. This is not your ordinary brownie; it is a professional-grade masterpiece with zero compromise on texture. A deeply fudgy bake with a decadent, liquid-like centre that remains stable yet incredibly rich. High-integrity, sophisticated, + utterly irresistible. THE INGREDIENTS 220 g organic 80% dark chocolate, finely chopped 200 g organic unsalted A2 butter 3 large organic pasture-raised eggs, at room temperature 170 g organic coconut blossom sugar 40 g organic raw cacao powder 80 g organic spelt flour 8 g flaky sea salt, plus extra for garnish THE METHOD Prep Station: Preheat oven to 175°C. Grease + line 20 cm baking tin. Melt Base: Melt butter + chocolate together using bain-marie, ensuring bottom of bowl does not touch water. Dissolve Sugar: Remove from heat, stir in sugar + salt until dissolved. Use wooden spatula instead of whisk to avoid incorporating air, keeping brownie dense. This step also cools mixture. Incorporate Eggs: Ensure mixture is warm, not hot. Add eggs one at a time, whisking between each addition until batter is completely homogenous + glossy. Sift + Fold: Sift flour + cacao powder into batter. Fold gently with spatula until just combined, taking care not to overwork it. Bake for Texture: Pour into tin, tap firmly to remove air bubbles, + finish with extra flaky salt. Bake for 22 minutes until top is set + skewer comes out slightly moist! SAVE this for when you need a serious chocolate fix. It is elite.

Servings: 6–8  Ingredients For the Roast 2 lb chuck roast Garlic powder, to taste Onion powder, to taste Black pepper, to taste Buttery garlic & herb seasoning, to taste @Kinder's Flavors  4 tbsp butter 1 packet au jus gravy mix @Fire & Smoke Society  1 packet beefy onion soup mix 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 2 cups chicken broth For the Onions 1 large yellow onion, thinly sliced 2 tbsp butter For Serving Hoagie or sub rolls Provolone cheese Instructions 1. Evenly season the chuck roast on all sides with garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, and buttery garlic & herb seasoning. 2. Melt 4 tablespoons of butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chuck roast and sear for 2–3 minutes per side, or until nicely browned. Transfer the roast to your slow cooker. 3. Sprinkle the au jus gravy mix and beefy onion soup mix over the roast. Add the Worcestershire sauce and chicken broth. 4. In the same skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of butter. Add the sliced onion and cook over medium heat for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly caramelized. 5. Spoon the onions directly over the roast. Cover and cook on LOW for 7–8 hours, or until the beef is fall-apart tender. 6. Remove the roast from the slow cooker and shred it with two forks. Return the beef to the slow cooker and toss it with some of the onions and juices. 7. Pile the shredded beef and onions onto your buns and top with provolone cheese. For extra melty cheese, pop the assembled sandwiches under the broiler for a minute or two. 8. Ladle some of the cooking liquid from the slow cooker into small bowls and serve alongside the sandwiches for dipping. #EasyRecipe #crockpot #slowcooker #DinnerIdeas #comfortfood

videos.caption: This Banana Omelet Tastes Like French Toast 🍳 🍌 ⸻ Ingredients ▶️ 1 ripe banana (120 g) ▶️ 2 large eggs ▶️ 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon ▶️ 1/2 tsp vanilla powder ▶️ Small pinch of sea salt ▶️ 1 tsp butter or extra-virgin olive oil (for the pan) ⸻ Preparation 1. Peel the banana and mash it in a bowl until mostly smooth. 2. Add the eggs, cinnamon, vanilla powder, and sea salt. 3. Whisk until well combined. 4. Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-low heat and lightly grease it with the butter or olive oil. 5. Pour the mixture into the skillet and spread it into an even circle. 6. Cook for 3–4 minutes, until the bottom is golden and the top is mostly set. 7. Carefully flip the omelet with a wide spatula and cook for another 2–3 minutes, until fully cooked through. 8. Fold the omelet in half and serve warm. ⸻ Tips (For Best Results) 💡 Use a ripe banana: The riper the banana, the sweeter and more French toast-like the flavor. 💡 Cook over medium-low heat: This allows the eggs to cook through without burning the banana. 💡 Mash the banana well: A smoother mixture creates a more even texture. 💡 Use a non-stick skillet: It makes flipping much easier. 💡 Flip gently: Wait until the omelet is mostly set before turning it over. 💡 Customize the toppings: Serve with fresh berries, Greek yogurt, chopped nuts, or a drizzle of honey. 💡 Enjoy immediately: The texture is best while warm. ⸻ Nutrition (1 omelet) ✅ Calories: ~260 kcal ✅ Protein: ~14 g ✅ Carbs: ~25 g ✅ Fat: ~11 g ✅ Fiber: ~3 g #bananaomelet #healthybreakfast #highproteinbreakfast #healthyfood #recipe

Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

High-Protein Green Spaghetti + Chicken 🥘  Easy 5-day meal prep  Per Serving💪: ~535 calories | 54g protein | 49g carbs Ingredients⬇️ * 3 poblano peppers * 2 garlic cloves * ½ white onion * Cilantro, to taste * 8 oz Philadelphia 1/3 Less Fat Cream Cheese * 1 cup LACTAID 1% Lowfat Milk * 2 tbsp chicken bouillon * 8 oz Barilla Protein+ Spaghetti * 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast * 1 tbsp olive oil Chicken seasonings * Garlic salt * Onion powder * Black pepper * Italian herbs Instructions ⬇️ 1. Roast the poblanos  Air fry 3 poblano peppers at 400°F for 10 minutes. Place them in a bag and let them sweat. Once softened, peel off the skins and remove the seeds. 2. Cook the pasta  Cook 8 oz Barilla Protein+ Spaghetti according to the package directions. Drain and set aside. 3. Make the green sauce Add the roasted poblanos, 2 garlic cloves, ½ white onion, 1 cup LACTAID 1% milk, 8 oz cream cheese, cilantro to taste, and 2 tbsp chicken bouillon to a blender. Blend until smooth and creamy. 4. Combine the sauce + pasta Heat a large pot over medium heat and pour in the green sauce. Once warmed through, add the cooked spaghetti and mix until evenly coated. 5. Prep the chicken  Slice 2 lb chicken breast into thinner pieces for even cooking. Season with garlic salt, onion powder, and black pepper. 6. Cook the chicken Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Cook the chicken until fully cooked through (165°F internal temperature), then finish with Italian herbs. 7. Meal prep  Divide the green spaghetti and chicken evenly between 5 containers Save this for your next meal prep! 🤍 #fyp #mealprep #healthy #gymmotivation #inspo

Marry Me Chicken Tortellini is an easy and delicious dinner recipe the whole family loves!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts, sliced into cubes  1/2 cup of flour  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder  2 TBSP olive oil 2 TBSP butter 2 TBSP of minced garlic 1 cup of chicken broth 1 cup of heavy cream 1 cup of Parmesan cheese 1 tsp of red pepper flakes  1/2 tsp each of oregano and thyme  1/3 cup of chopped sun dried tomatoes 19 oz bag of frozen tortellini  INSTRUCTIONS Mix together flour, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. Dredge chicken breasts into the flour/seasoning mixture.   In a skillet heat olive oil and butter on medium heat. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes on each side until golden brown and it reaches 165 degrees.  Take the chicken out of the skillet and put aside.  Add minced garlic, sun dried tomatoes, and chicken broth to the skillet. Lower heat and add heavy cream and Parmesan cheese. Stir well.  Add the red pepper flakes, oregano, and thyme. Stir together well and let simmer until it starts to slightly thicken (this could take at least five minutes).  Add one bag of frozen tortellini, cover, and let cook for a few minutes. The tortellini will also help thicken the sauce. Once tortellini is tender add chicken back to the skillet and serve. Enjoy! *This is a little bit spicy with 1 tsp of red pepper flakes, for less heat use 1/4 tsp!  #dinner #chicken #recipes

Valentine’s Day Dinner - Ep. 2: Spicy Vodka Chicken Parm Pasta 🔥❤️ recipe ⬇️ 1 large chicken breast, butterflied and pounded thin 2 eggs 2 cups seasoned breadcrumbs or use panko and season with salt, Italian seasoning, garlic & onion powder  1/4 cup parmesan cheese, freshly grated Slice chicken breasts in half. Place in a ziplock bag or plastic wrap. Pound with anything heavy until super thin. Dip in egg and then in seasoned breadcrumbs/panko. Press down so the breading sticks. Thoroughly spray with oil and air fry 380F for 10 min. Immediately sprinkle salt over fried chicken. Top with vodka sauce ⬇️ and slices of mozzarella. Air fry again for 1-2 minutes until cheese is melted.  Vodka Sauce 1 tbsp olive oil & butter 1/2 large onion, finely chopped 4-6 cloves garlic, minced 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes 1 & 1/2 tbsp tomato paste 1 or 2 shots of vodka, wine or broth 1 cup heavy cream 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 3/4 cup Parmesan 2 tbsp butter 8 oz pasta Melt butter and oil in a large pan. Sauté onion until translucent. Add garlic and red pepper flakes. Once fragrant add tomato paste and cook down for a few minutes. Pour in vodka and once most of it evaporates, incorporate heavy cream. Season with Italian seasoning, paprika and Parmesan cheese. Mix in al dente pasta along with more parm, pasta water and butter.  #pasta #chickenparm #vodkasauce #rigatoni #cheese

🌌🍫 Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake 🍫🌌 Ingredients: For the chocolate cake: 2 cups (250 g) all-purpose flour 2 cups (400 g) granulated sugar ¾ cup (75 g) unsweetened cocoa powder 2 teaspoons baking powder 1½ teaspoons baking soda 1 teaspoon salt 1 cup (240 ml) buttermilk, room temperature ½ cup (120 ml) vegetable oil 2 large eggs, room temperature 2 teaspoons vanilla extract 1 cup (240 ml) hot coffee (or hot water) For the chocolate ganache filling: 1½ cups (270 g) semi-sweet chocolate chips 1 cup (240 ml) heavy cream 2 tablespoons butter For the galaxy mirror glaze: 1 tablespoon gelatin powder ¼ cup (60 ml) cold water 1 cup (200 g) granulated sugar ⅔ cup (160 ml) sweetened condensed milk ½ cup (120 ml) water 1½ cups (270 g) white chocolate, chopped Gel food coloring (blue, purple, black, and pink) Edible glitter or luster dust (optional for stars ✨) Directions: Make the cake layers: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and line three 8-inch round pans with parchment paper. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Add buttermilk, oil, eggs, and vanilla. Mix until smooth. Gradually stir in hot coffee (batter will be thin). Divide evenly into pans and bake for 25–30 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool completely before assembling. Prepare the ganache filling: Heat heavy cream in a saucepan until just simmering. Pour over chocolate chips and butter in a bowl. Let sit for 3 minutes, then whisk until smooth and glossy. Allow to cool slightly before using. Assemble the cake: Place one cake layer on a serving plate. Spread a layer of ganache. Repeat with the second and third layers. Smooth the outside with ganache for a clean surface. Refrigerate for 1 hour to set. Prepare the galaxy mirror glaze: Sprinkle gelatin over ¼ cup cold water and let bloom for 10 minutes. In a saucepan, combine sugar, sweetened condensed milk, and ½ cup water. Bring to a gentle boil, then remove from heat. Add bloomed gelatin and stir until fully dissolved. Pour over chopped white chocolate and let sit for 5 minutes. Blend with an immersion blender until smooth (avoid bubbles). Divide the glaze into separate bowls and tint with food colors (blue, purple, black, and pink). Let the glaze cool to about 90°F (32°C). Create the galaxy effect: Pour the colored glazes into one large bowl in swirls (don’t mix). Pour the glaze over the chilled cake from the center outward, letting the colors blend naturally. Add edible glitter or luster dust for a starry galaxy look. Finish and serve: Let the glaze drip and set for 10–15 minutes. Slice and serve your stunning Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake! Nutritional Information (per slice): ⏰ Prep Time: 1 hour | Baking Time: 30 minutes | Chill Time: 2 hours | Total Time: ~3½ hours 🔥 Kcal: ~520 kcal per slice 🍽️ Servings: 12 This Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake is as mesmerizing as it is delicious — rich chocolate layers filled with creamy ganache and topped with a cosmic swirl of glossy glaze. Perfect for birthdays, celebrations, or anyone who loves desserts that are out of this world! 🌠 #GalaxyCake #MirrorGlaze #ChocolateDessert #CosmicBaking #ShowstopperCake

Prepare taco seasoning and once turkey is almost cooked, add taco seasoning and 1/2 c of water, stir and let cooked covered for 5 minutes on low 5. Once sweet potatoes and turkey are done, add to bowl with 1/2 slice avocado and cottage cheese 6.
